manualFollowUps: Merge, then let CI ship schood-sat-practice. The new app tolerates the old sat-practice function for the short window until the function is deployed (new pages show a retryable error instead of breaking).

Apply the migration: supabase db push --linked (only 20261026130900_sat_practice_engine_v2.sql from this release). It must run BEFORE the SAT content migrations 20261026140xxx-20261026143xxx, which rely on draft exclusion and the catalog. It is additive: create-or-replace of select/start/complete RPCs with identical signatures, a new catalog RPC, admin import RPCs and one widened check constraint; the currently deployed sat-practice function keeps working against it.

Secrets (existing ones only need checking with supabase secrets list): OPENROUTER_API_KEY is already set (only if missing: supabase secrets set OPENROUTER_API_KEY=<existing key>); OPENROUTER_MODEL and OPENROUTER_BASE_URL are optional (defaults google/gemma-4-31b-it:free and https://openrouter.ai/api/v1; never a paid model) — if set, keep supabase secrets set OPENROUTER_MODEL=google/gemma-4-31b-it:free and supabase secrets set OPENROUTER_BASE_URL=https://openrouter.ai/api/v1; AI_ADDON_PRODUCT_ID is unchanged (supabase secrets set AI_ADDON_PRODUCT_ID=<existing add-on product id> only if missing). Turn the tutor on with supabase secrets set SAT_TUTOR_SERVICE_DAILY_LIMIT=300.

Deploy the functions after the migration: supabase functions deploy sat-practice --project-ref <prod>, then supabase functions deploy admin-sat-practice --project-ref <prod> (new function; config.toml verify_jwt=false, authorised by the shared admin check admin.products.manage).
Then deploy the SAT content migrations (sat-math-a/b, sat-rw-a/b) with supabase db push --linked; content uses content_status published and appears immediately in bank, plans and modules.
verification: Local: deno tests (contract-A validator, SPR grading, SVG sanitiser, selection/plan/module builder, insights, goals, admin handler, tutor, existing completion/start/bank suites), deno check of both functions, app typecheck and build, uz/ru catalog completeness, 6 Playwright route tests with mocked network (bank filters, drill with mcq+spr+table+figure+KaTeX, timed module with navigator/flags/calculator, plan start, dashboard/onboarding, locale; 320/375px no horizontal overflow), and 13 PostgreSQL checks of the migration (scripts/test-sat-practice-engine-db.mjs) on a local PostgreSQL 18 cluster.

After deploy: open practice.sat.schood.online/bank and filter by official domain and skill; start a plan drill and confirm it holds the promised number of questions (or says honestly how many the bank has); start a Math module and check 22 questions/35:00 timer, navigator and calculator; submit and confirm the plan item turns Done and the dashboard minutes equal real elapsed time; score impact shows 'Not enough data yet' for a new learner.
Admin: open practice.sat.schood.online/admin as a content admin, validate a contract-A JSON file, import as draft (not visible in the learner bank), publish, then unpublish.
SQL: select count(*) from select_sat_practice_catalog('<test user>') equals the published SAT Practice questions; select_sat_practice_questions excludes content_status draft.

rollback.pages: Cloudflare Pages rollback of schood-sat-practice to the previous deployment.
rollback.functions: Redeploy the previous sat-practice function from main before this merge; the migration stays compatible with it. Delete or ignore admin-sat-practice (no other caller).
rollback.migration: Additive; leave in place. Previous function versions call the same RPC signatures. Learner history, receipts and frozen attempt snapshots are untouched. Drafted items can be republished with admin_set_sat_practice_item_status.
